name: Bhattacharyya Similarity for Material Boundaries
definition: A similarity measure between two clustering elements (material boundaries) based on the overlap of their bivariate normal probability density functions (PDFs) in the LH (Lightness-Hue) histogram space. It serves as the basis for hierarchical clustering in the LH space.
summary: Bhattacharyya Similarity for Material Boundaries measures the overlap of bivariate normal probability density functions in Lightness-Hue space to group visually similar boundaries based on statistical distribution rather than spatial connectivity.
